correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Gaussian edge-sign fan: positive generators do not alter hyperplane comparisons; iid Gaussian ranks induce uniform permutations. Acyclic orientations of K_{p,q} correspond bijectively to alternating maximal monochrome labeled blocks; each orientation has linear extensions equal to product of block factorials. Summing t-th powers after allocating labeled elements gives the formal generating function. For one large-side B-block, the complete weighted contribution is p!(q!)^t sum_{r=0}^p[r!(p-r)!]^{t-1}. For any b>=2 B blocks, the reciprocal binomial bound sum_{s=1}^{m-1} C(m,s)^-1<=4/m proves R_b(q)<=4^{b-1}(q-b+1)!; since b<=p+1 at fixed p, their total moment mass is a relative O(q^{-(t-1)}). It follows that collision-conditional condensation tends to one, and r-bias, entropy and vanishing unconditional condensation follow by exact normalization. Endpoints r=0,p and integer t>=2 handled; the finite checks are corroborative only.
